name: Wizard OS Tracker
short_desc: Wizard OS Goals and Bugs on GitHub: pipeline, bottlenecks and the full issue on tap.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Two views over a GitHub organisation: Goals and Bugs, each with a Queued → Building → Waiting for human pipeline, Done count, bottleneck stats, a Wizard OS Builder on/off switch (mock-up), the who-writes/who-builds policy, and Everyone/repo filters. Tap an issue to read it and its comments in the app. Each person signs in with their own GitHub token.
